statements.text: When Micron trades about 4 % below its all-time high inside a sideways phase on falling volume, the price fell in 78 % of 9 independent cases within 2 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Micron came back every time: in all 8 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 27 months at most.
After a fall of 40 % from its all-time high, Micron came back every time: in all 3 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 25 months at most.
